title: Tringify section schema
markdownDescription:
The `{% schema %}` of a section or theme block.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/section-schema)

name.markdownDescription: The section's name, unique in the theme. A theme block's name matches its file name.

markdownEnumDescriptions: A section merchants place on a page (default).
A section for a global surface such as the header or footer. Declares a `target`.
A section for the overlay layer, such as a cart drawer or popup. Declares a `target`.
A theme block in `blocks/`. No `target`, presets or `preview_image`.
Opening of `<body>`, before the page template: announcement bar, header.
End of `<body>`, after the page template: footer.
Overlay layer: cart drawer, localization prompt, popups.
target.markdownDescription:
The global surface a `layout` or `embed` section renders in.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/templates-and-surfaces#global-surfaces)

icon.description: The icon shown for the section in the editor.

preview_image.errorMessage: A theme image asset path such as assets/header-preview.png (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp or .gif).
preview_image.markdownDescription: A theme image (`assets/<name>.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.webp` or `.gif`) the editor shows for this section where merchants choose between interchangeable sections. Not for theme blocks.

ctx_needs.markdownDescription:
The store data the section reads. Declare a root such as `product`, or a dotted need such as `cart.item_count`. A section can read only what it declares.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/ctx/runtime-context)

items.errorMessage: Unknown CTX name. A ctx_needs entry is a CTX root, such as product or cart, optionally followed by a field: cart.item_count.

defaultSnippets.label: age_gate
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The store's age gate for this visitor: show is true when the gate applies to the visitor's country. Copy is already in the shopper's language, with the minimum age filled in. Render the gate as the global_overlay section age-gate, and render it only when ctx.age_gate.show is true: the platform adds its gate runtime only then, so a gate rendered while show is false can never be dismissed. Give its root data-tf-age-gate, role="dialog", aria-modal="true" and an aria-labelledby heading, and mark the buttons data-tf-age-gate-confirm and data-tf-age-gate-decline. The platform hides it before first paint for visitors who already confirmed, traps focus, stores the answer for remember_days days (0: the browser session) and handles declining (decline_url, or its own come-back-later screen when decline_url is empty). Keep the page content in the HTML. If the theme renders no age-gate section, the platform adds a plain one. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: auth_form
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Safe hosted-auth form replay state after a submission. Present after a hosted form submission.

defaultSnippets.label: auth_notice
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A localized sign-in or registration status message. Present after a hosted form submission.

defaultSnippets.label: back_in_stock_for_you
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Products this visitor viewed while they were sold out that can be bought again, the ones on their wishlist first, leaving out what they bought. Only for visitors who allow personalization; empty for everyone else. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: blog
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed blog landing page and paginated article cards. Provided on `blog` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: blog_category
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed blog category metadata. The blog root carries its paginated article cards. Provided on `blog_category` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: blog_post
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed blog article, author, categories, comments, and comment pagination. Provided on `blog_post` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: blog_recent
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A bounded route-free list of recent published article cards. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: brand
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed brand metadata and storefront-visible metafields. Provided on `brand` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: breadcrumbs
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The platform-resolved entity trail (items, last one current) and home, the store root named as the store is named, so a theme renders home then items in every language. Provided on its pages.

defaultSnippets.label: cart
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The current cart. Header use receives counts; rich cart surfaces receive line, price, discount, limit, and shipping data. A line whose product or variant can no longer be bought here (deleted, archived, unpublished, variant removed) is removed from the cart when a rich surface reads it; item_count then counts only the lines shown, and form_notice tells the shopper once. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: category
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed category metadata and storefront-visible metafields. Provided on `category` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: collection
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed collection metadata and storefront-visible metafields. Provided on `collection` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: consent
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Visitor consent state. available_categories lists the optional cookie categories the consent banner offers, in display order; categories lists the ones the visitor has granted. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: csrf_token
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The signed form nonce for hosted storefront mutations. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: customer
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The signed-in shopper and, when requested, their account addresses, orders, Gift Cards, and routed receipt. Requested; provided on `account` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: customer_settings
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Storefront-safe account, sign-in, registration, consent, and customer feature settings. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: design_mode
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: True while the theme editor renders the page for the merchant, false for shoppers. Use it to show placeholders for content the merchant has not chosen yet, and render nothing for shoppers instead. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: express
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Express checkout (wallet buttons such as Apple Pay and Google Pay) for the purchase on this page: on a product page the routed product's selected variant and quantity (the cart is untouched), on the cart page the cart, and in global chrome (a cart drawer) the cart on every page, refreshed with the drawer. Print ctx.express.slot where the buttons go, typically in an "Express checkout" block under Add to cart or Checkout, and nothing else for it. The slot is platform markup that the platform's own script turns into wallet buttons: themes never contain wallet code and must not restyle, move or remove its children. On a product page the script reads the selected variant and quantity from the page's cart_add form for ctx.product.id, and hides the buttons while a selection cannot use express checkout (variant_reasons, keyed by variant id) or the form carries line properties. When available is false the slot is empty; reason (a code) and reason_label (in the shopper's language) say why, for the theme editor or a short note. The buttons also stay hidden on a device without a wallet. Nothing here varies per visitor beyond market, currency, language and shopping mode, so pages stay cacheable. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: filters
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Platform-resolved filters and active filter state for the current product listing. Provided on `shop`, `search`, `collection`, `category`, `vendor`, `brand` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: form_error
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A localized validation error returned by a hosted form. Present after a hosted form submission.

defaultSnippets.label: form_notice
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A localized post-redirect result from a hosted storefront action. Present after a hosted form submission.

defaultSnippets.label: forms
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Hosted-action field requirements and length or media limits. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: gift_card
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: One Gift Card on the store's Gift Card page: null until a balance check succeeds in this request, or filled from the card's view link with its full code. After a failed check, or for a view link that opens nothing, it is null and ctx.form_error carries one message to show as given. Provided on `gift_card` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: list
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The generic vendor, brand, collection, or category index for the routed list page. Provided on `vendor_list`, `brand_list`, `collection_list`, `category_list` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: localization
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Current locale and the country and language choices enabled for this storefront. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: localization_prompt
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The platform decision for whether to offer a country or language change to this visitor. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: menus
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Available navigation menus keyed by handle. Resource picker settings resolve a selected menu to its full item tree. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: new_in_your_brands
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The newest products of the brands this visitor viewed, bought and saved, leaving out those products. Only for visitors who allow personalization; the rest of the list, or all of it without a brand, is the store's newest products. personal is true when at least one item comes from the visitor's brands. placement is the recommendation placement to send with a click (new_in_your_brands, or new_in_your_brands_newest without a personal item). Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: page
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed published content page. Provided on `page` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: pages
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Bounded route-free index of published content pages for navigation surfaces. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: phone_countries
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Localized phone country options allowed by the store's customer settings, sorted by name. min_digits and max_digits bound the national number (digits after the dial code); the server refuses any number that is not valid for its country. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: picked_for_you
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Products picked for this visitor from the brands and categories they viewed and bought, best sellers first, leaving out what they bought and the products in Recently viewed. Only for visitors who allow personalization; the rest of the list, or all of it without a personal pick, is the store's best sellers. personal is true when at least one item is a personal pick. placement is the recommendation placement to send with a click (picked_for_you, or picked_for_you_best_sellers without a personal pick). Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: policies
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Route-free index of published store policies for legal navigation. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: policy
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed published store policy. Provided on `policy` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: product
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed product with variants, options, pricing, availability, session state, and storefront-visible metafields. Provided on `product` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: products
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A routed product grid with platform search, sort, and pagination state. Provided on `shop`, `search`, `collection`, `category`, `vendor`, `brand` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: recently_viewed
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Visibility-gated product cards recently viewed on this device. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: restock_notifications
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Availability and channel rules for a product restock request form. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: reviews
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Product review availability, aggregates, filters, and approved review rows. Requested; provided on `product` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: routes
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Canonical storefront URLs using the store's locale, country, and permalink configuration. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: search
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The search query, grouped result totals, and canonical result projections. Provided on `search` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: shop
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Store identity, storefront-visible store metafields, and the active market's standing free-shipping offer. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: shopping
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: How the shopper is shopping: delivery, or pickup at one store location. In pickup mode every stock figure (product, card, filter, search, cart) is that location's stock, and checkout skips shipping. Switch with the shopping_mode_set action; shop.pickup_locations lists the locations offered to this shopper. A pickup location outside the shopper's market (or one that stopped offering pickup) resets the mode to delivery; on that request notice carries the message to show the shopper, and is null otherwise. In pickup mode catalog_notice names the location the catalog is shown for ("Showing products stocked at …" when pickup_location.stocked_only, else "Showing stock at …"): show it with a way to change the location wherever products are listed; it is null for delivery. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: still_thinking
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Products this visitor viewed and did not add to their cart or buy since, most recently viewed first, leaving out the product on the page: the browse-recovery reminder shown on the site. Only for visitors who allow personalization; empty for everyone else. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: store_reviews
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Store-wide approved reviews with product links and pagination. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

defaultSnippets.label: theme_preview
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: True when the page renders sample content in a theme preview (the theme store demo and the theme tooling preview), false on a store. Use it for a theme's own sample artwork where a merchant setting is empty; a store shows nothing there instead. Available on every page.

defaultSnippets.label: vendor
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The routed vendor metadata and storefront-visible metafields. Provided on `vendor` pages.

defaultSnippets.label: wishlist
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: The visitor's wishlist state and, for rich surfaces, its sellable product rows. Requested data, available on normal storefront pages.

migrations.markdownDescription:
Operations, in order, that carry merchants' saved settings and blocks across a change to this schema, such as a renamed setting or block type.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/section-schema#migrations)

presets.markdownDescription:
Ready-made versions of the section offered when a merchant adds one.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/section-schema#presets)

allOf.errorMessage: A theme block has no target.
A theme block has no presets.
A theme block has no preview_image.

accept_theme_blocks.errorMessage: A blocks slot on a theme block needs "accept_theme_blocks": true.

allOf.errorMessage: A theme block's blocks slot takes only theme blocks: no types of its own.

id.markdownDescription: Unique in the section or block. The template reads `settings.<id>`.

type.markdownDescription:
The setting type, which decides the editor control.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/section-schema#setting-types)

defaultSnippets.label: blog_category
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Search and pick one blog category. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.

defaultSnippets.label: blog_post
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Search and pick one blog post. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.

defaultSnippets.label: brand
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Search and pick one brand. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.

defaultSnippets.label: category
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Search and pick one category. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.

defaultSnippets.label: collection
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Search and pick one collection. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.

defaultSnippets.label: collection_list
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Pick and order several collections, up to `max`. The template reads a list of the picked items.

defaultSnippets.label: color
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Colour picker. The template reads a hex colour.

defaultSnippets.label: color_scheme
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: One of the theme's colour schemes. The template reads the scheme's id.

defaultSnippets.label: datetime
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Date and time in the store's time zone. Stored as wall time without an offset, such as `2026-12-01T09:00`.

defaultSnippets.label: image
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Image from the media library. The template reads an image URL; use `image_url`.

defaultSnippets.label: menu
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Menu picker. The template reads the menu from `settings.<id>_resolved`.

defaultSnippets.label: metafield
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Pick one of the store's metafield definitions for the resource named by `owner` (required). The template reads `{namespace, key, handle}`.

defaultSnippets.label: number
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Number input. The template reads a number.

defaultSnippets.label: object
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A group of the declared `fields`. The template reads an object of field values.

defaultSnippets.label: page
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Search and pick one page. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.

defaultSnippets.label: point
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A spot on the image setting named by `image` (required), placed by clicking or dragging. The template reads `x` and `y`, percentages (0–100) of the image's width and height.

defaultSnippets.label: policy
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Search and pick one policy. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.

defaultSnippets.label: product
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Search and pick one product. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.

defaultSnippets.label: product_list
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Pick and order several products, up to `max`. The template reads a list of the picked items.

defaultSnippets.label: product_source
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: A live product feed: a category or collection, optionally narrowed to one tag, with an order and a count up to `max`. The template reads `entity`, `url` and `products`.

defaultSnippets.label: range
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Slider. Needs `min` and `max`; `step` and `unit` are optional. The template reads a number.

defaultSnippets.label: richtext
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Rich text editor. The template reads formatted HTML, cleaned of anything unsafe.

defaultSnippets.label: select
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Drop-down. Needs `options`. The template reads the chosen option's `value`.

defaultSnippets.label: text
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Single-line text. The template reads text.

defaultSnippets.label: textarea
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Multi-line text. The template reads text.

defaultSnippets.label: url
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Link. The template reads a URL.

defaultSnippets.label: vascula
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Code editor. The template reads the rendered output of the merchant's Vascula code.

defaultSnippets.label: vendor
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Search and pick one vendor. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.

defaultSnippets.label: video
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription: Video from the media library. The template reads a video URL.

default.description: The value a new section starts with.

fields.markdownDescription: For `object`: the fields of the value, each with a unique `key`.

max.markdownDescription: For `range` (required) and `number`: the highest value. For `product_list`, `collection_list` and `product_source`: the most items (12 if not set).

unit.markdownDescription: For `range`: the unit shown after the value, such as `px`.

image.markdownDescription: For `point` (required): the id of the `image` setting the point sits on, in the same block or its section. Only `point` settings take `image`.

type.markdownDescription: The field's control. Any setting type except `metafield` and `point`.

required.description: The merchant must fill the field.

max.description: The field's maximum, such as the most characters.

group.description: Set by the platform on font_picker options. Themes do not write it.

editor.markdownDescription: Present on every setting merchants edit. A setting without `editor` is runtime data the host fills, and is not shown to merchants. `label` and `group` can be literal text or keys from `locales/<locale>.schema.json` (`fieldLabel.<label>`, `fieldGroup.<group>`).

label.description: The setting's or block's label in the theme editor.

group.description: The editor group the setting appears in, such as content or settings.

icon.description: For block types: the block's icon in the theme editor.

visibleIf.markdownDescription:
Show the setting in the editor only while another setting of the same section or block has one of `values`, or, with `set`, while it has a value (`true`) or is empty (`false`). Give exactly one of `values` and `set`.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/section-schema#settings)

setting.description: The id of the other setting.

values.description: The values that show this setting.

set.description: true: show this setting while the other one has a value (an image picked, text entered). false: while it is empty.

then.errorMessage: visible_if takes exactly one of values and set.

types.description: The block types this section defines.

default.description: The blocks a newly added section starts with. Every type must be declared.

max.description: The most blocks a merchant can add. Omit for no limit.

accept_theme_blocks.markdownDescription:
Accept the theme's shared theme blocks (`blocks/<name>.vasc`), stored as `theme:<name>`. Place `{% blocks %}` where they render. Blocks nest up to 4 levels.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/theme-blocks)

items.errorMessage: A theme block name, as in blocks/<name>.vasc, without theme:.

theme_blocks.markdownDescription: Accept only these theme blocks (names of `blocks/<name>.vasc`, without `theme:`), such as only slides in a slideshow. Needs `accept_theme_blocks`. Omit to accept every theme block.

accept_app_blocks.description: Accept blocks from the merchant's installed apps.

type.description: The block type. Unique in the section.

allOf.errorMessage: A block type needs at least one setting with an editor block.

settings.markdownDescription: The block's settings. At least one has an `editor` block.

name.description: The preset's name in the editor's "Add section" list. Unique in the section.

category.description: The category the preset is listed under.

type.description: A declared block type, or theme:<name> for a theme block the section accepts.

migration.markdownDescription:
An operation that carries merchants' saved settings across a schema change.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/section-schema#migrations)

id.description: Unique among the migrations. Never reuse one.

markdownEnumDescriptions: A local block type was renamed: `from_type` to `to_type` (a declared type, or `theme:<name>` the section accepts).
A setting was renamed in the same scope: `from` to `to`.
A setting moved to another scope (section ↔ local block type): `from` to `to`.
A setting was dropped on purpose: `from` only.
Fill a value for a new setting `to` in saved sections that lack it: `default`.
Two retired number settings (`from` horizontal, `from_y` vertical) become the point setting `to`.
Retired settings become theme blocks in `settings.blocks`: `blocks`.

source_defaults.description: settings_to_blocks, or rename_block to a theme block: the retired settings' old defaults.

then.errorMessage: from_type and to_type are only for rename_block.

allOf.errorMessage: rename_block does not take from, to or default.

remove_setting does not take to or default.
